title: Transcriptomics-informed design of a dual phytochemical hydrogel enables immuno-redox modulation and accelerated healing in infected burns.
authors: Sharma, Vikash; Kumar, Ashish; Orayj, Khalid; Akhtar, Md Sayeed; Khan, Abida; Singh, Machiavelli; Mukherjee, Monalisa; Sharma, Arun K
journal: European journal of pharmaceutics and biopharmaceutics : official journal of Arbeitsgemeinschaft fur Pharmazeutische Verfahrenstechnik e.V
one_liner_zh: 该文利用转录组学和分子对接设计植物化学水凝胶治疗感染烧伤，虽涉及转录因子和分子对接，但核心是伤口愈合材料而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Infected burn wounds require advanced integrative therapies capable of addressing both microbial burden and dysregulated inflammation. This study reports a transcriptomics-guided phytochemical-engineered alginate hydrogel designed to modulate immuno-redox pathways and promote regenerative repair, offering a multi-targeted strategy for infected burn management. Transcriptomic profiling, network pharmacology, and molecular docking were employed to identify inflammatory mediators and transcriptional regulators associated with infected burn pathology, including IL1B, TNF, FOS, and CXCL8. A Conessine- and alpha-Mangostin-loaded alginate hydrogel (CalphaMLAH) was synthesized, optimized using a Quality-by-Design approach, and characterized for physicochemical properties. In-vitro assessments included drug release and biocompatibility evaluations, while therapeutic efficacy was investigated in a murine infected burn model using wound closure kinetics, bacterial burden, biochemical assays, histopathology, and molecular analyses. Transcriptomic analysis identified differential regulation of inflammatory genes and transcription factors associated with immune signaling pathways. Molecular docking predicted favorable interactions between the phytoconstituents and inflammatory mediators. The optimized CalphaMLAH formulation exhibited physicochemical stability, sustained drug release, favorable rheological characteristics, excellent hemocompatibility, and antibacterial activity. In-vivo treatment was associated with accelerated wound closure, reduced bacterial burden, and improved inflammatory and redox profiles. Histological and molecular findings further suggested enhanced re-epithelialization, collagen organization, and attenuation of NF-kappaB/AP-1-associated transcriptional programs, accompanied by reduced expression of REL, JUNB, and related transcription factors. Collectively, these findings support the potential utility of CalphaMLAH as a transcriptomics-guided, multifunctional therapeutic platform for infected burn wounds. The integration of molecular target prioritization with biomaterial engineering highlights the potential of transcriptomics-guided phytochemical formulations for advanced wound management and infection-associated inflammatory disorders.
abstract_zh: 感染性烧伤创面需要能够同时应对微生物负荷和炎症失调的先进整合性疗法。本研究报道了一种基于转录组学指导的植物化学工程海藻酸盐水凝胶，旨在调节免疫-氧化还原通路并促进再生修复，为感染性烧伤管理提供多靶点策略。通过转录组学分析、网络药理学和分子对接，识别了与感染性烧伤病理相关的炎症介质和转录调控因子，包括IL1B、TNF、FOS和CXCL8。合成了一种负载Conessine和alpha-Mangostin的海藻酸盐水凝胶（CalphaMLAH），采用质量源于设计（Quality-by-Design）方法进行优化，并对其理化性质进行了表征。体外评估包括药物释放和生物相容性测试，而治疗功效则在鼠感染性烧伤模型中通过伤口闭合动力学、细菌负荷、生化检测、组织病理学和分子分析进行研究。转录组学分析识别了与免疫信号通路相关的炎症基因和转录因子的差异调控。分子对接预测了植物成分与炎症介质之间的有利相互作用。优化后的CalphaMLAH制剂表现出理化稳定性、持续药物释放、良好的流变特性、优异的血液相容性和抗菌活性。体内治疗与加速伤口闭合、减少细菌负荷以及改善炎症和氧化还原状态相关。组织学和分子发现进一步提示了再上皮化增强、胶原组织化以及NF-kappaB/AP-1相关转录程序的减弱，伴随REL、JUNB及相关转录因子表达降低。总体而言，这些发现支持CalphaMLAH作为转录组学指导的多功能治疗平台在感染性烧伤创面中的潜在应用价值。分子靶点优先排序与生物材料工程的整合，突显了转录组学指导的植物化学制剂在先进伤口管理和感染相关炎症性疾病中的潜力。
